stem: What is an Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) used for?

options.text: To document how a product conforms to accessibility standards
options.rationale: Records the results of an accessibility conformance evaluation.

options.text: To certify that a product is legally compliant in every country
options.rationale: An ACR documents conformance, not universal legal certification.
An ACR reports evaluation results; it does not replace testing.

options.text: To list the prices of assistive technology
options.rationale: An ACR is not a price list.

explanation: An ACR documents how a product conforms to accessibility standards, usually by recording the results of an accessibility conformance evaluation.
